scope: Targeted candidate-factor grounding from E0-E3 and primary research, not an exhaustive novelty survey.

papers.title: Revisiting Fundamentals of Experience Replay
papers.supports: Replay capacity and replay ratio are distinct variables with algorithm-dependent effects.
papers.boundary: Q-learning results are background; they do not establish the direction or cause of E3 SAC allocation effects.

papers.title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
papers.supports: Conflict, relative gradient magnitude and curvature are considered jointly in detrimental multi-task interference.
papers.boundary: Negative cosine alone is not a verified predictor of long-horizon SAC success or a causal diagnosis of E3 forgetting.

papers.title: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations
papers.read: Versioned author abstract and ICRA 2018 metadata
papers.supports: Demonstrations and useful experience address exploration difficulties in sparse-reward robot tasks.
papers.boundary: Our rewards are dense. This source motivates an exploration candidate; it does not diagnose our low-success tasks or authorize demonstration training.

papers.title: Addressing Function Approximation Error in Actor-Critic Methods
papers.supports: Function approximation error and value overestimation affect actor-critic methods.
papers.boundary: TD error, critic loss and twin-critic disagreement are not calibrated measures of learning value or uncertainty in our SAC.

papers.title: The Primacy Bias in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.supports: Over-reliance on early experience can impair subsequent learning in tested RL settings.
papers.boundary: Plasticity loss has not been measured here. Resetting parameters would be a separate intervention, not just a diagnostic feature.

papers.title: The Dormant Neuron Phenomenon in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.read: Abstract, definition and Appendix B including Figures 18-20 and Table 6
papers.supports: Dormant neurons arise in actor/critic networks, including SAC. The paper studies recycling dormant capacity.
papers.boundary: Standard-size SAC MuJoCo conditions showed maintenance rather than gains from ReDo; narrower networks showed some gains. Dormancy alone is not proof of a performance bottleneck.

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
papers.supports: Small numbers of RL runs and variable results require explicit uncertainty and careful comparisons.
papers.boundary: Large numbers of branches or evaluation episodes do not replace independent pretraining seeds; this project preserves its frozen macro objective.

papers.title: Aioli: A Unified Optimization Framework for Language Model Data Mixing
papers.read: Abstract and framework findings; previous v18 review of sections 4-5 and 8
papers.supports: Dynamic mixing-law parameter estimation is prior work; its tested LM laws can be well specified while estimated coefficients are inaccurate.
papers.boundary: It does not establish nonlinear mixture or ordering effects in our SAC. Dynamic response estimation alone is not a novelty claim.

papers.title: Transferability for General Reasoning: An Automated Curriculum for Multi-Domain RLVR
papers.read: Primary text gradient/advantage method passages, alongside prior v18 review
papers.supports: Gradient/advantage-based transfer-aware curriculum signals already exist in multi-domain RLVR.
papers.boundary: RLVR is distinct from replay-based robot SAC; an adaptation is not a reproduction of the original setting.
